channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: How much more are you spending on petrol since the war on Iran began?
item.description: At least 145 countries have reported increases in petrol prices since the attacks on Iran by the US and Israel began.

item.title: Pakistan’s army chief back in Iran: Can he break peace talks deadlock?
item.description: Pakistan says it can offer a channel between Tehran and Washington, but analysts differ over how much influence it has.

item.title: ‘We know this movie’: Iran mocks latest US sanctions
item.description: Abbas Araghchi said new US sanctions, likely to be unveiled Monday, are like watching the 'same movie on repeat'.

item.title: Syria, Israel hold US-mediated talks in Jordan to de-escalate tensions
item.description: Syria's foreign minister meets Israeli officials to de-escalate tensions after Israeli strike near Turkish border.

item.title: Iran war live: US vows ‘economic D-Day’; Tehran threatens Gulf oil exports
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Washington aims to 'sever every economic lifeline' that sustains Iran.

item.title: Will Donald Trump’s new sanctions against Iran work?
item.description: The US president says he will impose 'crushing measures' on Tehran.

item.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
item.description: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.
